settings.folders.label: Wallpaper folders
settings.folders.description: Folders to show (not recursive). Empty uses Noctalia's wallpaper folder.
settings.image_extensions.label: Image extensions
settings.video_extensions.label: Video extensions
settings.gif_extensions.label: Animated image extensions
settings.color_groups.label: Colour groups
settings.color_groups.description: Name = hue range in degrees (e.g. 200-255). Ranges may wrap past 360. Unsaturated wallpapers go in 'mono'.
settings.color_min_saturation.label: Minimum saturation for a colour
settings.color_min_saturation.descriptio: Pixels below this count as mono when picking a wallpaper's colour group.
settings.thumbnail_width.label: Thumbnail width (px)
settings.thumbnail_width.description: Existing thumbnails are not remade; delete the thumbs folder in the plugin data directory to rebuild.
settings.thumbnail_jobs.label: Parallel thumbnail jobs
settings.default_view.label: View the bar widget opens first
settings.cards_per_side.label: Cards on each side
settings.side_width_ratio.label: Side card width
settings.side_width_ratio.description: Width of a side card relative to the centre card.
settings.dim_per_card.label: Dim per card
settings.dim_per_card.description: How much each step away from the centre fades a card (0.5 = gone after two steps).
settings.card_gap.label: Card gap (px)
settings.card_radius.label: Card corner radius (px)
settings.animation_ms.label: Slide duration (ms)
settings.info_name_width.label: Info bar file name width (px)
settings.live_preview.label: Live preview
settings.live_preview.description: Apply the centre card whenever the deck stops moving.
settings.outputs.label: Outputs
settings.outputs.description: Connector names to apply to (e.g. eDP-1). Empty applies to all.
settings.scale.label: Video scaling
settings.fps_cap.label: Video FPS cap
settings.loop.label: Loop videos
settings.when_hidden.label: When covered by windows
settings.gst_options.label: Extra gSlapper options
settings.glyph.label: Icon
settings.wrap.label: Loop around at the ends
